title: Nutty, Snappy Brazilian Whole Wheat Paillote
description: A flavorful and nutritious Brazilian dish made with whole wheat, papillote, and a hint of mustardy spice.

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Brighten up the dish with fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: Crushed macadamia nuts
ingredients.notes: Add some crunch and nutty flavor.

instructions: Roll out the whole wheat pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Brush the dough with coconut oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Top the dough with the ground turkey breast, diced onions, and chopped cilantro.
Sprinkle the Brazilian-style mustard and crushed macadamia nuts over the top.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a papillote, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
